title: Rebate Administration Manual: Quarterly Accrual, Guarantees, Payment and Offset under the PBM Services Agreement
content:
Rebates owed to a plan sponsor under its PBM Services Agreement are booked as the sponsor's rebate payable: manufacturer rebates and guarantee amounts owed to the sponsor and not yet paid. Quarterly accruals raise it; payments and offsets lower it.

## Section 1 — The quarterly accrual

Each quarter the sponsor accrues the arrangement's rebate pass-through share of the manufacturer rebates on its claims. Where the agreement has rebate guarantees, the accrual is at least the guaranteed amounts times the quarter's brand retail, brand home delivery and specialty prescriptions.

Stated as a definition of the quantities:

- **Pass-through amount** — the manufacturer rebates on the sponsor's claims for the quarter, multiplied by the rebate pass-through share.
- **Guaranteed amount** — the brand retail guarantee multiplied by the quarter's brand retail prescriptions, plus the brand home delivery guarantee multiplied by the quarter's brand home delivery prescriptions, plus the specialty guarantee multiplied by the quarter's specialty prescriptions.
- **Accrual** — where the guarantees apply, the higher of the pass-through amount and the guaranteed amount; where they do not apply, the pass-through amount alone.

## Section 2 — When the guarantees apply

The rebate guarantees apply only while every member of the sponsor is on a formulary in the arrangement's list of guarantee formularies and, when the arrangement requires an exclusive specialty program, on an exclusive specialty program; otherwise the quarter accrues the pass-through share only.

| Every member on a listed guarantee formulary | Arrangement requires an exclusive specialty program | Every member on an exclusive specialty program | Quarter accrues |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | No | (not required) | The higher of the pass-through amount and the guaranteed amount |
| Yes | Yes | Yes | The higher of the pass-through amount and the guaranteed amount |
| Yes | Yes | No | Pass-through amount only |
| No | either | either | Pass-through amount only |

An arrangement whose guarantees are all zero has no rebate guarantee; its quarters accrue the pass-through amount.

## Section 3 — Payment and offset

3.1 Rebates are paid at the arrangement's rebate payment frequency. A quarter's accrual is paid within the arrangement's payment lag, in calendar days, after the quarter ends; the annual guarantee true-up is paid within the arrangement's true-up period, in calendar days, after the contract year ends.

3.2 When the arrangement allows the offset election and the sponsor elects it, an accrual is applied as a credit memo against a named open invoice instead of being paid.

3.3 Each accrual is settled once, by payment or by offset. An accrual already paid is not offset, and an accrual already offset is not paid.

## Section 4 — Worked examples (hypothetical figures throughout)

Hypothetical terms: pass-through share 100%; guarantees of 200.00 per brand retail, 500.00 per brand home delivery and 1000.00 per specialty prescription; the guarantee conditions of Section 2 are met. Hypothetical quarter: 100 brand retail, 20 brand home delivery and 10 specialty prescriptions.

- Guaranteed amount: 200.00 multiplied by 100 gives 20000.00; 500.00 multiplied by 20 gives 10000.00; 1000.00 multiplied by 10 gives 10000.00; the total is 40000.00.
- If manufacturer rebates for the quarter are 50000.00, the pass-through amount is 50000.00 and the accrual is the higher figure, 50000.00.
- If manufacturer rebates are 30000.00, the pass-through amount is 30000.00 and the accrual is 40000.00.
- If, in that second quarter, some member is on a formulary outside the guarantee list, the guarantees do not apply and the accrual is 30000.00.
- Under a hypothetical pass-through share of 85%, manufacturer rebates of 30000.00 give a pass-through amount of 30000.00 multiplied by 0.85, that is 25500.00.
